svg.title: The Riemann Hypothesis: The Real Part and One Bit · Figure 2 · Riemann's Division Made Exact
svg.text: RH: THE REAL PART AND ONE BIT · MASTER v3.0.39_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
RIEMANN, NOVEMBER 1859 · ONE SENTENCE, THREE CLAUSES, THREE KINDS
“etwa so viel reelle Wurzeln innerhalb dieser
about as many real roots within these bounds
counted in 1859; proved here at every computed
height, now or in the future
“es ist sehr wahrscheinlich, dass alle Wurzeln reell
it is very probable that all the roots are real
the remainder graded probable: no off-line zero
“ein strenger Beweis zu wünschen … bei Seite
a rigorous proof would be desirable; its search set
the proof from symmetry, the record and
no zero above T off the line
At every height T, RH is exactly its real part and its unicorn part: nothing
lost, nothing added, for every zero set with natural heights.

svg.text: Given the real part at T, RH is exactly the unicorn part at T: no route reaches

svg.text: THE FUSION LAW · KEEP THE PARTS APART
the real part fused with the unicorn part stands open
A conjunction stands only as high as its weaker part. Every proof of the fused statement contains a proof of the unicorn part, and fusion lowers the proved real part to
open. Kept apart, the real part is asserted exactly as proved and borrows nothing; the remainder is located, not dissolved.
GRADE · theorem, on no axiom, in the volume file RH_Gold_And_Lead.lean (1.4)
